meaning: Proposal mapping, not ratification or executed archive move. Historical paths predict agreed mechanics.

records.title: ADR-0000: Core Premise — Contract-First, Surface-Agnostic Design
records.notes: Core invariants; reconcile incoming deployment scope and replace stale terms/artifact paths.

records.title: ADR-0001: Naming Conventions — Guessable API Through Structural Rules
records.notes: Structural grammar, accessor verbs, paths and scope distinctions; current lexicon owns current words.

records.title: ADR-0002: Built-In Result Type
records.notes: Shared Result construction/serialization; current owner taxonomy replaces duplicated tables.

records.title: ADR-0003: Unified Trail Primitive
records.notes: One trail replaces hike; typed objects plus dynamic string escape hatch replace string-only prose.

records.title: ADR-0004: Intent as a First-Class Property
records.notes: Read/write/destroy and orthogonal idempotency; surface mappings derive from owner facts.

records.title: ADR-0005: Framework-Agnostic HTTP Route Model
records.notes: Framework-neutral HTTP routes survive; old package examples become history.

records.title: ADR-0006: Shared Execution Pipeline with Result-Returning Builders
records.notes: One execution pipeline survives; use current layers/permits/resources/recovery, not obsolete stage order.

records.title: ADR-0007: Governance as Trails with AST-Based Analysis
records.notes: Rules are trails, source analysis uses AST, diagnostics are structured data.

records.title: ADR-0008: Deterministic Surface Derivation
records.notes: Pure deterministic surface derivation; reconcile current overlays/accommodations.

records.title: ADR-0009: First-Class Resources
records.notes: Declared resource lifecycle, typed access, eager resolution, mocks and governance survive.

records.title: ADR-0010: Trails-Native Infrastructure Pattern
records.notes: Partial supersession: inspectable infrastructure/bootstrap survive. Retire mandatory trifecta, old state paths and package splits; incoming auth remains explicit.

records.title: ADR-0011: Schema-Driven Config
records.notes: Deployment config and provenance survive; static project identity is specialized by ADR-0054. Resource config schemas compose into typed context; config.ref lazy trail defaults survive.

records.title: ADR-0012: Adapter-Agnostic Permits
records.notes: Authored policy, resolved permits, extraction/enforcement separation survive. Incoming OAuth/CLI changes must reconcile bearer-only scope.

records.title: ADR-0013: Tracing — Runtime Recording Primitive
records.notes: Partial supersession: recording, sampling and lineage survive under current core/observability ownership.

records.title: ADR-0014: Core Database Primitive
records.notes: Shared SQLite, restricted writes and subsystem ownership survive; repo-local placement does not. Owner-only shared-SQLite writes and read-only consumer access remain explicit.

records.title: ADR-0015: Topo Store
records.notes: Queryable graph, snapshots/pins and read-only analysis survive; current artifact authority follows ADR-0054.

records.title: ADR-0016: Schema-Derived Persistence
records.notes: Schema-first store becomes resource when bound; backend-neutral protocol replaces SQL assumptions.

records.title: ADR-0017: The Serialized Topo Graph
records.notes: Partial supersession: inspectable committed graph survives; old manifest/content pair and layout do not.

records.title: ADR-0018: Signal-Driven Governance
records.notes: Ordinary trails/signals for governance survive. Named framework signal/lock-export examples are absent; dev-intelligence aspirations require explicit disposition.

records.title: ADR-0019: Hierarchical Command Trees from Trail IDs
records.notes: Full dotted command paths, executable parents, explicit overrides and graph visibility survive.

records.title: ADR-0020: Flags for Fields, Structured Input on the CLI
records.notes: Truthful flags/positionals, structured input channels and one validation boundary survive.

records.title: ADR-0021: Draft State Stays Out of the Resolved Graph
records.notes: Draft markers, contamination/exclusion, visible debt and promotion survive independently of ADR prose status.

records.title: ADR-0022: Drizzle Binds Schema-Derived Stores to SQLite
records.notes: Store binding and SQLite/Drizzle example survive; with-drizzle name historical, backend procedure stays in fieldguide.

records.title: ADR-0023: Simplifying the Trails Lexicon
records.notes: Brand-versus-plain heuristic survives; historical term census does not.

records.title: ADR-0024: Typed Trail Composition
records.notes: Typed and dynamic composition, composition-only input and merged validation survive.

records.title: ADR-0025: Composition Testing
records.notes: Examples, assertion strengths, subset semantics, scenarios/references and real-pipeline testing survive.

records.title: ADR-0026: Error Taxonomy as Transport-Independent Behavior Contract
records.notes: Taxonomy behavior and complete mappings survive; keep current class/code tables owner-derived.

records.title: ADR-0027: Trail Visibility and Surface Filtering
records.notes: Public/internal visibility, selectors, intent/profiles/permits and subtractive exposure survive under current overlay rules.

records.title: ADR-0028: Concurrent Trail Composition
records.notes: Ordered all-branch results, bounded concurrency and independent branch resource scopes survive.

records.title: ADR-0029: Adapter Extraction and Composition Around Core Contracts
records.notes: Native/third-party binding boundaries and dependency direction survive; with-* packaging historical.

records.title: ADR-0030: Contours as First-Class Domain Objects
records.notes: Domain identity/schema/examples survive as entity; contour naming historical. Preserve typed .id() references/branded identity, structural reference edges and operational trail/entity relationships.

records.title: ADR-0031: Backend-Agnostic Store Schemas
records.notes: Backend-neutral schema, binding realization, versions and change signals survive.

records.title: ADR-0032: deriveTrail() and Trail Factories
records.notes: Factories produce ordinary trails; deriveTrail is lower-level, domain packages own families.

records.title: ADR-0033: Detour Execution for Recovery
records.notes: Typed ordered bounded detours, retryability overrides and exhaustion survive; narrow reconcile exception remains.

records.title: ADR-0034: Store Accessor Contract Refinement: Lessons from Two Backends
records.notes: Portable equality, accessor tiers, identity/generated fields, versions and correctness-only pagination survive.

records.title: ADR-0035: Surface APIs Render the Graph
records.notes: Derive/create/surface responsibility ladder survives; update examples to current exports.

records.title: ADR-0036: Warden rules ship only as trails
records.notes: Public rule trails and registry; raw rule objects stay private.

records.title: ADR-0037: Owner-First Authority
records.notes: One typed owner and rule-local policy boundary survive; merge ownership law with ADR-0051.

records.title: ADR-0038: Typed Signal Emission
records.notes: Typed signals, producer/consumer edges and observable consumer failures survive.

records.title: ADR-0039: Reactive Trail Activation
records.notes: Activation is ordinary invocation; source declaration and runtime materialization remain distinct. Guards filter without transforming input; payload validation and context/trace provenance remain intrinsic.

records.title: ADR-0040: Resource-Scoped Store Signal Identity
records.notes: Resource-scoped derived signal identity and late binding survive; ambiguous binding fails closed.

records.title: ADR-0041: Unified Observability
records.notes: Current observability owner split survives; removed compatibility package is history.

records.title: ADR-0042: Core/Topography Boundary Doctrine
records.notes: Core in-memory versus Topography durable facts; runtime artifact independence remains law.

records.title: ADR-0043: Layer Evolution
records.notes: Fixed framework stages, declared layer inputs and implementation isolation survive.

records.title: ADR-0044: Trail Versioning
records.notes: Explicitly superseded by ADR-0048; no independent normative clauses, only versioning lineage.

records.title: ADR-0045: v1 Resolved Graph Error Scope
records.notes: Authored/derived/inferred/observed distinction; no exhaustive runtime-error claims.

records.title: ADR-0046: Lock v3 Artifact Family
records.notes: Explicitly superseded by ADR-0054; preserve durable-graph/migration rationale through successor, not old container/layout.

records.title: ADR-0047: Stable Release Line Discipline
records.notes: Lockstep family and 0.x compatibility survive; one-time source reset is historical. Preserve latest/explicit-prerelease policy, visible retirement, cold scaffold gate, publish-role split and evidenced partial-publish recovery.

records.title: ADR-0048: Trail Versioning v3
records.notes: Sole current versioning model: explicit historical schemas, revisions/forks, lifecycle, markers and negotiation.

records.title: ADR-0049: Composition is `compose`, not `cross`
records.notes: Current compose vocabulary survives; migration story historical.

records.title: ADR-0050: Surface Accommodations Preserve Trail Identity
records.notes: Identity/fork test survives through current scalar/list overlay carrier.

records.title: ADR-0051: Package Ownership Follows Natural Altitude
records.notes: One natural reusable owner; consumers compose rather than reimplement.

records.title: ADR-0052: Overlays Are the Lock's One Extension Mechanism
records.notes: One extension/provenance/hash/preservation mechanism; app-authored binding authority and shared collection survive.

records.title: ADR-0053: Regrade Moves Governed Contract Change
records.notes: Owner facts, reviewable plans, conservative apply, compact immutable receipts and durable governance survive.

records.title: ADR-0054: Project Substrate Names Its Truth
records.notes: App-owned locks, static identity, partitioned views, machine-local observations and proven freshness survive. Preserve shared operator selection/context, root/app/config/module precedence, command cardinality and provenance, plus project/working-tree/collection-root distinctions.

records.title: ADR-0055: MCP Targets the Stateless Core on SDK v2
records.notes: Accepted target-state must survive; implementation gaps do not downgrade status or prove delivery.

records.title: ADR: Direct Trail Invocation (`trails run`)
records.notes: Fold verified full-pipeline invocation; retain only unresolved operator ergonomics. Old option/vocabulary inventory historical.

records.title: ADR: External Trailheads as Trails
records.notes: Rewrite rig/external integration factories around ordinary trails; current API and need remain unratified.

records.title: ADR: Pack Resources
records.notes: TRL-995 retains this as a future draft depending on rewritten pack boundaries. Refresh resource vocabulary; do not silently consolidate away the candidate.

records.title: ADR: Packs as Namespace Boundaries
records.notes: TRL-995 keeps pack as an intentional working brand/primitive candidate. Rewrite the first future pack-boundary draft; acceptance still needs the few-primitives test.

records.title: ADR: WebSocket Trailhead
records.notes: TRL-1166 replaces custom envelope/process-local replay with RPC direction; durable subscription owner controls replay.

records.title: ADR: Declarative Search
records.notes: Keep search proposal; refresh store/role/adapter boundaries underTRL1552 before ratification.

records.title: ADR: Documentation freshness SLAs
records.notes: TRL-995 reframes this as documentation-as-a-service/docs-governance exploration, not just freshness SLAs. Routine policy may live in contributor guidance; preserve the framework-facing future idea.

records.title: ADR: Documentation structure
records.notes: Preserve enough for a docs-structure baseline ADR or issue per TRL-995. Whether it belongs in active product canon remains an explicit owner decision; routine policy belongs in contributing guidance.

records.title: ADR: Resource Bundles
records.notes: Keep a future grouped resource defaults/overrides stub per TRL-995. Factory-not-primitive insight may feed N07; do not overcommit to historical mechanics.

records.title: ADR: Wayfinding
records.notes: Current Wayfinder ownership/query model feeds N14; speculative residue stays explicit, old draft not automatically ratified.

records.title: ADR: Scaffold Forward Compatibility
records.notes: Carry verified pin/provenance/lifecycle principles after cutoff check; public upgrade tooling remains future.

records.title: ADR: Adapter authoring as a paved path
records.notes: Owner-export/conformance principles feed canon; unfinished catalog/scaffolding remains future; no runtime adapter primitive.

records.title: ADR: Fixes are Warden diagnostic metadata
records.notes: Current Warden fix metadata and Regrade consumption verified;0053 owns evolved lifecycle.

records.title: ADR: One-Schema Trail Input
records.notes: TRL-884 Done plus 851a2a3cb/current source support schema-owned caller/materialized typing; preserve type-cost/schema restrictions.

records.title: ADR: Surface Trailheads Shape Dense Topos
records.notes: Preserve identity/visibility; retire standalone grouped carrier in favor of ADR-0052 overlays.

records.title: ADR: Release Provenance as Lifecycle Derivation
records.notes: Facts/rules/intent/output distinction survives; current stack policy replaces Graphite-specific mechanics.

records.title: ADR: Library Surface and Compiler
records.notes: Runtime library surface and shared compiler plan exist; future binary/compiled aspirations remain separate.

records.title: ADR: Verdicts Run on Stable Ground
records.notes: shift error and repo tree guard exist; public warden guard command remains future.

records.title: ADR: CLI Command Routes Normalize Into Trail Contracts
records.notes: Same-contract route normalization survives; current overlay carrier replaces parallel alias exports.

records.title: ADR: Addressable Facts, Dynamic Queries
records.notes: Shared query ownership feeds canon; MCP URI/resource rendering remains incoming unless cutoff source proves it.

records.title: ADR: Merge-Friendly Lock v6
records.notes: TRL-1424 Done for drafting only; retain lossless saved-library, overlay/force retention and migration gates; no v6 delivery claim.
